Proposition
[Volume of a symmetric ideal prism] \group reflection-polyhedra Source: thurston:page-0180, thurston:page-0181

\[ \operatorname {Vol}(\mathcal N_{\alpha ,\beta }) =n\left(2\Lambda (\beta /2)+\Lambda (\alpha +\pi /n)+\Lambda (\alpha -\pi /n)\right). \]
Proof

\sketch Subdivide into $n$ congruent sectors and add the cone on the upper triangular face while subtracting the equal-volume cone on the lower face. The resulting quadrilateral cone has side angles $\beta /2$ and front/back angles $\alpha \pm \pi /n$, by the ideal polygonal-cone angle sum and volume formula.
